# An enemy bullet: a glowing ball 0.44 m across (unlit; the ink rings it in red-orange). Pivot at its centre.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Foe --base-color 0.937 0.847 0.631 --no-slot --emission 0.937 0.847 0.631
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.22 --location 0 0 0
material assign Foe
select all
shade flat
export bullet.glb
